abilities.name: sturdy
abilities.effect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead.  Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

abilities.name: weak-armor
abilities.effect: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

kanto.flavorText: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to black-colored diamonds.

original-johto.flavorText: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

hoenn.flavorText: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an ONIX from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It squirms through the ground using its long and rugged body. It always eats while burrowing.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.

updated-johto.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

original-unova.flavorText: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.

updated-unova.flavorText: Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.

kalos.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Onix has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this Pokémon does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

swsh.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

pla.flavorText: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.
